description: File blocks: gaps, element and byte caps (255 B), slots, T/C and ST reads (D-008).

vectors.description: Contiguous elements merge into one {n} read.
A single element is read without {n}.
Default max_gap 4: a 4-element hole merges.
A 5-element hole splits.
max_gap 0: only touching elements merge.
max_gap 10.
max_elements caps word files: 120 N elements split 100 + 20.
max_elements 10.
max_elements 1: one element per read.
Default request_size 232 B: 58 floats per read.
request_size 100 B: 25 floats, 50 words per read.
request_size 1000 is clamped to 255 B (one-byte PCCC size field): 127 words, 63 floats.
L elements are 4 bytes: 58 per default read.
Holes count toward the element cap.
Different files (N7, N9, B3) never share a read; blocks sorted by file.
I/O words merge only within one slot.
Status file words merge like data words.
Each T/C sub-element is its own one-element read.
The same timer sub-element under two names is one read.
ST reads hold at most 2 elements.
With request_size 255 three 84-byte ST elements would fit, but pycomm3 accepts only {1} or {2}: still 2 per read.
Two names on one address: one element, two items.
Bits of one word and the word itself: one element; items ordered by bit (word first), then name.
B3/0 .. B3/47 span elements 0..2.
I:0/0 and I:0/35 span words 0..2 of slot 0.
Disabled tags are not read.
Tags in reverse order plan the same.
No tags: no blocks.
